senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; v. preced.) [cutting down,] pestilence; ק׳ or ק׳ מרירי [bitter, deadly disease], Ḳeṭeb (M’riri), name of a demon.
units: <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:29">Lam. R. to I, 3</cite> <he>ביומן דעקא … שבהם ק׳ מ׳ מצוי</he> in the days of anguish, from the seventeenth of Tammuz to the ninth of Ab, during which Ḳ. M. is about.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 12:3">Num. R. s. 12</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 91:6">Ps. XCI, 6</cite>) <he>שד … שמו ק׳ וכ׳</he> it is a demon, and why is his name Ḳeṭeb? &c., v. <cite ref="B00430"><he>בְּזַז</he></cite>, <cite ref="C00538"><he>גְּזַז</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Psalms 91:6">Ib.</cite> <he>ק׳ מ׳ עשוי וכ׳</he> Ḳ. M. is covered with peeling crusts, with hairs and with eyes; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 842:4">Yalk. Ps. 842</cite>; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 91:3">Midr. Till. to Ps. XCI</cite>.
<cite ref="Pesachim 111b:9">Pes. 111ᵇ</cite> <he>חזייה להאי ק׳ מ׳ וכ׳</he> he said K. M. coming to his left side.
